title: docs(grid): scope the rich text cell panel wording to the select-first grid
body:

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbGyo1s5XDjcEx7u8WDqbFTx)_
Fixes #36360
Part of #35155 (item 3 only, the two "(empty)" doc comments; items 1-2 stay on that card)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 读文档的开发者:说明从"富文本单元格都在格子下方面板里编辑"改为分开写清"选中优先表格"与普通表格两种行为;用户界面无感。
- 属于列表单元格编辑富文本那项工作的收尾,替照着文档挂载普通表格的人纠正误导。
- 只改文字与注释,出错只是说明不准,可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

Text only, no code or behaviour change. Each text that described the rich-text cell panel now names the select-first grid (`cellSelection`) for the panel and its keys, and says in one sentence what a grid without `cellSelection` does:

- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/README.md` (ships in the npm tarball): panel sentence scoped; adds the non-select-first sentence.
- `ui/packages/fields/README.md` (ships): same.
- `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-grid.mdx`: panel sentence scoped (its keys sentence already was); adds the non-select-first sentence.
- `ui/packages/fields/src/FieldEditWidget.tsx`: jsdoc on `IN_CELL_PANEL_EDIT_WIDGETS` only.
- `.changeset/36023-rich-text-cell-panel.md` (pending, not yet consumed by a release): the "Before" line now says the "This field can't be edited in a list" notice was the select-first grid's.
- `.changeset/36360-rich-text-panel-wording.md`: new patch note for the two published READMEs.
- Second commit (rider, #35155 item 3): `GroupRowProps.label` in `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/GroupRow.tsx` and the doc comment in `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/temporalCellFace.ts` now say an empty group key is labelled with the grid's `grid.empty` string ("Empty" in English, `useGroupedData.ts` `emptyLabel = t('grid.empty')`), not "(empty)". Comments only.

**DELIBERATE CORRECTION** of the pending note `.changeset/36023-rich-text-cell-panel.md` (Check Changeset's foreign-changeset rule stays red by design). Corrected sentence: "Before, these cells opened no editor; on a select-first grid the cell said "This field can't be edited in a list"." Reason: the notice comes from `cellSelection.describeCell`, which only a select-first grid has (`factsOf` in `data-table.tsx`).

Every clause was measured in `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx` at the base:
- panel placement: `editsBelow = isEditing && selectFirst && editorBelow`, else `placement: 'cover'` (over the cell);
- one click opens: the non-select-first `onClick` calls `startEdit` under `singleClickEdit`, which `ObjectGrid` defaults to `true`;
- Ctrl/Cmd+Enter in the injected TEXTAREA commits only under `selectFirst && (ctrlKey || metaKey)`;
- Esc: `exitEdit(true)` on both hosts;
- click outside: the document `pointerdown` listener calls `saveEdit(true)`, which stages; without `autosaves` (`selectFirst && onRowSave`) the staged value waits for the save bar (`hasPendingChanges && !autosaves`).

## Tests

No tested behaviour changed, so no tests and no ablation.

## Acceptance notes

- The select-first panel sentence says "a click outside saves"; measured, an immediate save needs `autosaves` (`selectFirst` plus `onRowSave`); a select-first grid wired with `onBatchSave` alone keeps the save bar. Not changed here (outside the card's wording); noted only.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `git diff origin/main...HEAD -- ui/packages/plugin-grid/README.md` shows the panel bullet now opening "on a select-first grid (`cellSelection`)" and a second sentence for a grid without it.

Files to read first: `ui/packages/plugin-grid/README.md` (published), `.changeset/36023-rich-text-cell-panel.md` (the corrected pending note).
